result.markdown:
# Incident Report: Traffic Drop at S-TUN-007

- **Classification:** planned_maintenance
- **Root cause:** planned_maintenance at `LNK-TUN-02-C`
- **Confidence:** high (Direct evidence of planned maintenance MW-0002 on the parent fiber link matching the exact timing of the LINK_LOS and SITE_DOWN alarms, and traffic/availability anomaly ALR-0016. External events NOT CHECKED.)
- **Impact:** 2026-09-09 02:15 to 2026-09-09 05:45
- **Cause time:** 2026-09-09 02:19
- **Affected:** S-TUN-007, S-TUN-010, S-TUN-014

## Summary

Planned fibre splice work on parent transport link LNK-TUN-02-C caused downstream sites S-TUN-007, S-TUN-010, and S-TUN-014 to go offline.

Traffic, active users, and availability dropped to zero at S-TUN-007 (along with sibling sites S-TUN-010 and S-TUN-014) from 2026-09-09 02:15 to 05:45.

## Timeline

- 2026-09-09 02:19: Planned maintenance MW-0002 started on LNK-TUN-02-C for fibre splice work [MW-0002]
- 2026-09-09 02:15: Availability drop and traffic anomaly started on S-TUN-007, S-TUN-010, and S-TUN-014 [ALR-0016]
- 2026-09-09 02:26: Critical LINK_LOS alarm raised on LNK-TUN-02-C [ALM-000159]
- 2026-09-09 02:27: Critical SITE_DOWN alarms raised on S-TUN-007, S-TUN-010, and S-TUN-014 [ALM-000160, ALM-000161, ALM-000162]
- 2026-09-09 04:31: Software upgrade CHG-2026-0023 performed on CORE-UPF-01 [CHG-2026-0023]
- 2026-09-09 05:41: LINK_LOS and SITE_DOWN alarms cleared on LNK-TUN-02-C, S-TUN-007, and S-TUN-014 [ALM-000159, ALM-000160, ALM-000162]
- 2026-09-09 05:52: Planned maintenance MW-0002 completed on LNK-TUN-02-C [MW-0002]

## Evidence

- Traffic, active users, and availability dropped to zero at S-TUN-007 from 2026-09-09 02:15 to 05:45. [ALR-0016, ANM-000131, ANM-000127, ANM-000132]
- Planned fibre splice work took place on parent transport link LNK-TUN-02-C between 2026-09-09 02:19 and 05:52. [MW-0002]
- Critical LINK_LOS on LNK-TUN-02-C and SITE_DOWN alarms on S-TUN-007, S-TUN-010, and S-TUN-014 occurred during the maintenance window. [ALM-000159, ALM-000160, ALM-000161, ALM-000162]

## Hypotheses

1. **planned_maintenance** at LNK-TUN-02-C: confirmed. MW-0002 explicitly scheduled fiber splice work on LNK-TUN-02-C with expected downstream impact, matching the exact time of the traffic drop and LINK_LOS/SITE_DOWN alarms. [MW-0002, ALM-000159, ALM-000160]
2. **bad_change** at CORE-UPF-01: rejected. Software upgrade CHG-2026-0023 occurred at 04:31, whereas the traffic drop and link failure started earlier at 02:15/02:19. [CHG-2026-0023, ALR-0016]
3. **power_failure** at S-TUN-015: rejected. Mains failure and site down alarms on S-TUN-015 cleared on 2026-09-08 21:58, hours before the incident at S-TUN-007. [ALM-000142, ALM-000148]

## Ruled out

- CHG-2026-0023: Occurred at 2026-09-09 04:31, after the outage had already started at 02:15.
- ALM-000142: Mains failure on S-TUN-015 cleared on 2026-09-08 21:58, prior to the incident window.
- ALM-000163: VSWR high minor alarm on S-TUN-008 occurred after the incident recovery at 2026-09-09 06:14.
